title: Identity verification
subtitle: Verify your identity to unlock DOOM FLEX.

UNVERIFIED.title: Your identity is not verified yet
UNVERIFIED.text: It takes a few minutes: confirm your details, photograph both sides of your ID card and take a selfie.

PENDING.title: Your documents are under review
PENDING.text: Our team is reviewing your submission. You will receive a notification with the decision.

DOCUMENTS_REQUESTED.title: Additional documents requested
DOCUMENTS_REQUESTED.text: Upload the documents listed below to complete your verification.

VERIFIED.title: Your identity is verified
VERIFIED.text: You can now apply for DOOM FLEX instalment plans.

REJECTED.title: Your verification was not approved
REJECTED.text: Read the reason below, then submit new documents.

details.title: Confirm your details
details.text: They must match your identity document.
details.fullNameHint: Exactly as written on your ID card.
details.phoneMissing: Add a mobile number to your profile before continuing.

docs.title: Photograph your documents
docs.text: Use good light, avoid reflections and make sure every corner is visible.

hint.ID_FRONT: The side with your photo and name.
hint.ID_BACK: The other side of the same card.
hint.SELFIE: Your face, clearly visible, without sunglasses.

docs.formats: JPEG, PNG or WebP · max 8 MB

review.title: Review and submit
review.text: Check that each photo is sharp and readable.
review.consent: I confirm these documents are mine and authentic, and I agree to their processing for identity verification as described in the privacy policy.
review.encryption: Encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before storage. Only authorised reviewers can open them, and every access is logged.

privacy.title: How we protect your documents
privacy.encrypted: Encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM, in private storage.
privacy.access: Opened only by authorised reviewers; every access is logged.
privacy.minimal: Kept only as long as necessary, then deleted.
privacy.law: Processed under Oman's Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022).

errors.too_large: This file is larger than 8 MB.
errors.heic_unsupported: HEIC photos are not supported. Set your camera to "Most compatible" (JPEG) or choose another photo.
errors.unsupported_type: Unsupported format. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.image_unreadable: This image could not be read. Try another photo.
errors.already_pending: Your documents are already under review.
errors.phone_required: Add a mobile number to your profile first.
errors.consent_required: Please confirm the statement to continue.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Your documents could not be sent. Please try again.
